bake.occlusion: none — the whole hull is baked, keel included; the sheet is never cut at the water
bake.clipRule: engine clips at pivot.y + motion().waterPx, or leaves it whole for a dry buoy
bake.rows: topY / keelY / bbox are MEASURED painted rows — the union of the alpha bounding box over the 8 facings, fresh and derelict. zHiModel / zLoModel are model-space z in metres (paint extents), NOT sheet rows: the tower and topmark rise above zHiModel and the skirt hangs below zLoModel.
bake.crop: crop and pack from bbox, never from zHiModel/zLoModel

PortCan.name: Port hand
PortCan.gloss: Keep on your LEFT going upstream. Odd numbers. The SHAPE is the mark.

StbdNun.name: Starboard hand
StbdNun.gloss: Keep on your RIGHT going upstream. Even numbers.

PortLit.name: Port hand, lighted
PortLit.gloss: The steel one. Channel edge in the shipping lane.

CardinalN.name: North cardinal
CardinalN.gloss: Black over yellow. Safe water to the NORTH.

CardinalS.name: South cardinal
CardinalS.gloss: Yellow over black. Safe water to the SOUTH.

CardinalE.name: East cardinal
CardinalE.gloss: Black-yellow-black. Safe water to the EAST.

CardinalW.name: West cardinal
CardinalW.gloss: Yellow-black-yellow. Safe water to the WEST.

Isolated.name: Isolated danger
Isolated.gloss: Black with a red band. A rock, with water all round it.

SafeWater.name: Safe water
SafeWater.gloss: Red and white stripes. Fairway — pass either side.

Special.name: Special purpose
Special.gloss: All yellow, saltire on top. Cables, spoil, races.

Regulatory.name: Regulatory
Regulatory.gloss: White with orange bands. The shape on it is the rule.

Mooring.name: Mooring
Mooring.gloss: White with a blue band. Tie up here.

Spar.name: Spar / winter buoy
Spar.gloss: What replaces the steel ones before the ice comes.

sizes.label: 1.8 m
sizes.role: the working default — most of the marks in a bay

sizes.label: 3.0 m
sizes.role: landfall and offshore — the ones you see from the ferry

calm.label: Glass calm
calm.note: Harbour at dawn. The chain is what moves.

chop.label: Harbour chop
chop.note: Short and steep. Tilts as hard as a gale and heaves almost nothing.

working.label: Working sea
working.note: A day you can still haul in.

rough.label: Rough
rough.note: The small hulls go green over and the chain snubs hard.

swell.label: Swell, no wind
swell.note: Long and low. Big slow heave, barely any tilt — nothing else does this.
